polishes.name: Maniacs Tonic
polishes.description: Maniacs Tonic should not be taken lightly! Known to drive the alchemist mad with the technical expertise required to make such a concoction! Maniac Tonic is a thermal nail lacquer that shifts from a blurple (cold) to white (warm) with cyan to blue to purple shifting shimmer and holographic flakes. Maniacs Tonic is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Darkness of Night
polishes.description: Darkness of Night is enough to darken anyone’s soul! A finely crafted brew distilled in the wee hours of the night, when no creature stirs and only during the new moon! Darkness of Night is a multichrome polish that shifts from deep blue to purple to red. Darkness of Night is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Essence of Insanity
polishes.description: Essence of Insanity is distilled from only the finest of sources; hours of doomscrolling on Instagram and TikTok! Modern alchemy has truly improved! Essence of Insanity is a plum jelly nail lacquer with fold to green to blue shifting shimmer. Essence of Insanity is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Hexbane Brew
polishes.description: Hexbane Brew will protect the strongest of alchemists from the horrors of the world, but mostly it will make you sleepy! Hexbane Brew is a darkened indigo jelly nail lacquer with green to blue to purple shifting shimmer and holographic flakes. Hexbane Brew is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Elixir of Chaos
polishes.description: Elixir of Chaos is crafted in that very moment of sheer panic when you are out to dinner with friends and you wonder if you forgot to turn off the iron! Now you can share with everyone! Essence of Insanity is a navy-blue jelly nail lacquer with pink to gold to green to turquoise shifting shimmer and holographic flakes. Elixir of Chaos is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Botanical Ambrosia
polishes.description: Botanical Ambrosia is a divine nectar made only from the rarest of plants! Said to have actually been divined from the corpse flower itself (but with none of the smell)! Botanical Ambrosia is a darkened teal jelly nail lacquer with red to orange to gold to green shifting shimmer and holographic flakes. Botanical Ambrosia is part of the Alchemist's Vault collection.

polishes.name: Rainbow Reflections
polishes.description: Rainbow Reflections is a rainbow reflective glitter topper in a clear base. In normal lighting this polish will appear gray and in order for the rainbow reflection to show, direct light must be applied. Without flash, this polish will appear gray. Please note that this polish has no holographic components at all. Swatches display with and without flash as noted on each picture. Rainbow Reflections is part of Alchemy Basics.

polishes.name: Gold Kaleidoscope
polishes.description: Gold Kaleidoscope is a micro holographic gold glitter topper in a clear base. Gold Kaleidoscope is part of Alchemy Basics.

polishes.name: Carbon
polishes.description: Carbon is a black crème nail lacquer that is full coverage in 1-2 coats, depending on density of application. Carbon is part of the Alchemy Basics Collection.

polishes.name: Copper Kaleidoscope
polishes.description: Copper Kaleidoscope is a micro holographic copper  glitter topper in a clear base. Copper Kaleidoscope is part of Alchemy Basics.

polishes.name: Scarlet Kaleidoscope
polishes.description: Scarlet Kaleidoscope is red micro holographic glitter topper in a clear base. Scarlet Kaleidoscope is part of the Alchemy Basics Collection. Swatches display (from left to right) one coat alone, two coats alone and 1 coat over Love Struck.

polishes.name: Silver Kaleidoscope
polishes.description: Silver Kaleidoscope is a micro holographic silver glitter topper in a clear base. Gold Kaleidoscope is part of Alchemy Basics.

polishes.name: Obsidian Kaleidoscope
polishes.description: Obsidian Kaleidoscope is black holographic micro glitter topper in a clear base. Obsidian Kaleidoscope is part of the Alchemy Basics Collection. Swatches display (from left to right) one coat alone, two coats alone and 1 coat over Carbon.

polishes.name: Electric Bloom

polishes.name: Pink Static
polishes.description: Pink Static is a bright pink jelly nail lacquer with green to turquoise to blue shifting iridescent flakes and holographic flakes.This shade is a group custom celebrating the fourth anniversary of the facebook group, ALL the Polishes.

polishes.name: Opal

polishes.name: Galaxy

polishes.name: Hologram

polishes.name: Prism

polishes.name: Sterling

polishes.name: Hyacinth Macaw

polishes.other_colors: Blue, Gold, Green, Orange, Pink, Purple
polishes.description: Neon Nightmare is a solar nail lacquer that shifts from coral neon orange in the shade to purple in the sun with gold to green turquoise shifting shimmer. Neon Nightmare is part of the Summerween Collection. A note about solar nail lacquers: Certain top coats that contain the ingredients etocrylene AND benzophenone, which are UV absorbers, can diminish the effectiveness of the transition capabilities of solar nail lacquers. For maximum effect, We recommend using our Solar Shine top coat for maximum effect. Additionally, there are many variables that factor into transitions of solar nail lacquers. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct UV rays, just like thermals depend on body temperature. There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity level. All swatchers used indoor UV lights/lights, which will have the absolutely strongest transition. Solar nail lacquers are also delicate when it comes to extreme temperature changes, especially during transit that can affect the transition abilities of the nail lacquer. Do not leave them in extreme heat or cold for extended periods of time. To increase the longevity of a solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep the bottle in a dark place with consistent temperatures.

Ingredients: Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Isopropyl Alcohol, Cellulose Acetate Butyrate, Acetyl Tributyl Citrate, Acrylates Copolymer, Etocrylene, Violet #2 Alchemy Lacquers are all hand blended, in a 4-free base (unless otherwise indicated).
